children: VINCE HOLDING CORP. reported third-quarter FY2026 results with revenue of $81.8M, up from $73.2M a year earlier, while net income fell to $10.6M and diluted EPS declined to $0.8 versus $0.93 in the year‑ago quarter.
Revenue: $81.8M for 3Q FY2026, compared with $73.2M in the prior-year quarter; YoY change 11.7%.
Net income: $10.6M for 3Q FY2026, compared with $12.1M in the prior-year quarter; YoY change (12.1%).
Diluted EPS: $0.80 for 3Q FY2026, compared with $0.93 in the prior-year quarter; YoY change (14.0%).
Revenue growth: Net sales rose 11.7% for the quarter and 11.2% year‑to‑date, driven by higher shipments and strength in retail and e‑commerce.
Channel shift: Direct‑to‑consumer comparable sales increased about 18% for the quarter and YTD, reflecting gains in e‑commerce and store volume.
Margins: Both Vince wholesale and direct segments improved gross margins, aided by tariff refunds that boosted profitability.
Strategic moves: Completed acquisition of OVO operating companies and secured an exclusive license to OVO IP, taking a 5% equity stake in ABG OVO.
Store footprint: Operates 53 stores (41 full‑price, 12 outlet), a net reduction of 5 stores versus the prior year.
